{{Quote|I'm Kima Nazith, the Senator's bodyguard. I was told that you were a capable agent willing to help insure Senator Naberrie's safety. There's a matter that I cannot attend to myself so I could certainly use your help. The Imperials have bought off one of our Gungan informants. This individual is being escorted to Mal Sikander even as we speak. If this Gungan talks, we could all be in big trouble. Can I rely on you to neutralize this threat?|Kima Nazith to a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]]|<ref name="SWG:AED">{{GalaxiesAED}}</ref>}}
'''Kima Nazith''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] that lived during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. She was an active member of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] and worked as a bodyguard for [[Pooja Naberrie/Legends|Pooja Naberrie]]. She once hired a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] to kill [[Hrodius Goragg]], a [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] working for the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].
